description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families across three model types: mBERT, XLM-R, and “same”. The horizontal axis represents language families, labeled IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “task count”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  For each language family, there are three adjacent bars representing the task count for each model. The mBERT bars are colored dark blue, the XLM-R bars are colored light blue, and the “same” bars are colored light green. For IE-Baltic, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 9, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 6, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 11.  For IE-Germanic, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 21, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 16, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 12. The tallest bars are for mBERT on the IE-Romance language family, reaching a value of approximately 37, while the shortest bar is for mBERT on the Isolate language family, reaching a value of approximately 2. The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing one bar for each model type. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
